problem_text:
A city planner needs to allocate a fixed budget across 19 different infrastructure projects to maximize the overall community benefit score. The profile for each project is as follows:
* Project A: benefit score 0.124, impact factor 0.054, allocation bounds [0.068, 0.737]
* Project B: benefit score 0.026, impact factor 0.200, allocation bounds [0.058, 0.530]
* Project C: benefit score 0.137, impact factor 0.173, allocation bounds [0.057, 0.884]
* Project D: benefit score 0.138, impact factor 0.143, allocation bounds [0.057, 0.853]
* Project E: benefit score 0.100, impact factor 0.259, allocation bounds [0.081, 0.337]
* Project F: benefit score 0.183, impact factor 0.051, allocation bounds [0.007, 0.450]
* Project G: benefit score 0.084, impact factor 0.238, allocation bounds [0.003, 0.322]
* Project H: benefit score 0.045, impact factor 0.201, allocation bounds [0.072, 0.750]
* Project I: benefit score 0.179, impact factor 0.278, allocation bounds [0.023, 0.565]
* Project J: benefit score 0.103, impact factor 0.030, allocation bounds [0.065, 0.525]
* Project K: benefit score 0.022, impact factor 0.253, allocation bounds [0.049, 0.679]
* Project L: benefit score 0.048, impact factor 0.150, allocation bounds [0.067, 0.318]
* Project M: benefit score 0.110, impact factor 0.289, allocation bounds [0.032, 0.404]
* Project N: benefit score 0.175, impact factor 0.186, allocation bounds [0.023, 0.365]
* Project O: benefit score 0.058, impact factor 0.062, allocation bounds [0.076, 0.570]
* Project P: benefit score 0.182, impact factor 0.215, allocation bounds [0.090, 0.380]
* Project Q: benefit score 0.115, impact factor 0.157, allocation bounds [0.078, 0.682]
* Project R: benefit score 0.112, impact factor 0.201, allocation bounds [0.010, 0.634]
* Project S: benefit score 0.051, impact factor 0.085, allocation bounds [0.086, 0.417]

Each project must receive a budget share within its specified minimum and maximum bounds, and the sum of all budget allocations must equal the total available budget. To prioritize essential services, the planner requires that the group of high-priority projects, represented by the set L = {A, B, C, D, F, G, H, I, J, L, M, O, P, Q, R, S}, collectively receive at least 0.847 of the total budget. Additionally, the total community disruption, measured by a composite impact index, must not exceed 0.203, and the overall benefit score must be at least 0.072. Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total benefit score while satisfying all constraints.
